verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's docs say the assistant remembers things by writing plain Markdown files to the agent's workspace (default `~/.openclaw/workspace`). The model only remembers what is saved to disk, and the gateway runs self-hosted on the user's own machine, so the memory store is local and in an open, human-readable format. Being able to inspect, edit and delete memory follows from these being plain files, but the docs never describe it directly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of editing or deleting memories (UI/CLI or confirmation that manual edits are honored), clarity on whether SQLite session history also counts as remembered data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
